name: illustrator-mixed-outlines
exporter: Adobe Illustrator 2024 (28.6) - Export As > SVG, Styling: Presentation Attributes
story: A 'coming up next' band where the designer ran Type > Create Outlines on the show logotype only - so the licensed display face travels inside the file as five glyph paths under the original layer name - and left the episode line and the airtime as live type; they expect two operator fields plus the logotype offered, unticked, as a recoverable outline row.
idioms: Generator comment naming the SVG Export Plug-In build
root attrs in Illustrator's order with x="0px" y="0px", viewBox/width/height and xml:space="preserve" on tab-indented continuation lines
Styling: Presentation Attributes - no <style> block at all, fill/font-family/font-size written as attributes
font-family attribute carrying the PostScript name in inner single quotes: font-family="'Archivo-Bold'"
font-size attribute with a px unit: font-size="46px"
opacity emitted as a wrapper <g opacity="0.94"> around the panel rect rather than on the rect
outlined type keeps the layer name on its group: id="Show_x20_title" data-name="Show title", with one <path> per glyph and no <text> inside
path d data with commas between coordinate pairs, one decimal place, and Illustrator's line wrapping mid-path onto tab-indented continuation lines
attribute order fill before width/height on <rect>
_x20_ escapes with data-name holding the original spelling
tab indentation, one tab per nesting level
whyThisMatters: Partly outlined files are the normal state of a broadcast Illustrator document - the licensed logotype gets outlined, the copy stays live - so an importer that treats 'has outlines' as the outlines road refuses a file with two perfectly bindable text layers, and one that treats 'has live text' as the happy path never offers the logotype at all; this fixture fails on either mistake.
